about.title: About SoftSutra
about.lead: SoftSutra is an independent software initiative founded by Raman Sharma and based in Village Sarsa, Pehowa, Kurukshetra, Haryana, India. We build fast, privacy-respecting browser tools that work across devices and remain useful even when the network does not.

sections.heading: Our mission
paragraphs: Useful software should be immediate, understandable and affordable. SoftSutra turns everyday digital friction — a loan calculation, a network slowdown, a mock test, a repeated mantra, a document handoff — into focused tools that open in a browser without an install ceremony.

We publish original guides beside every tool so readers understand the decision behind the number or result. This editorial layer is written for people, not for ad networks, and it helps contextual advertising stay relevant without interrupting the task.

sections.heading: How the ecosystem is organised
paragraphs: The portal at {{ROOT_DOMAIN}} is the discovery layer. Six focused applications live on sibling subdomains so each product can keep its own performance budget, offline cache and release cadence:

Exam supports national and state mock-test practice; Jap supports digital mala counting and a Vedic calendar preview; Music focuses on distraction-free listening; Calculator covers exact money and measurement work; Speed measures real network behaviour; Cafe helps cyber cafés and customers move documents without USB media.
bullets: Domain-agnostic routing: the same codebase serves the active parent domain chosen at runtime.
Local-first state: preferences and in-progress work are stored on the device with IndexedDB.
App-convertible surfaces: relative assets, semantic HTML and a single ad wrapper keep future native wrapping straightforward.
Accessible by default: semantic landmarks, visible focus, keyboard-operable controls and 44px touch targets.

sections.heading: Engineering standards
paragraphs: Money uses decimal arithmetic with half-up rounding, never binary floating point. Heavy work is isolated from first paint. Ad containers reserve their physical space before scripts load, so the page does not jump while an advert arrives.

We do not ask for more data than a tool needs. Where a feature can run fully on-device, it does. Where a cloud endpoint is genuinely required, its purpose is described in the relevant privacy section.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what the SoftSutra portal stores locally, which third parties may receive data when you view an advert, and the choices available to you.

sections.heading: Information you provide
paragraphs: Most tools need no account and no personal details. If you use the contact form, you provide a name, an email address, a category and your message. Those values are validated in the browser and saved to IndexedDB on your device; they are not transmitted by this portal.
Individual subdomains may offer optional profiles, histories or saved sessions. Those features are governed by the notice shown inside the relevant application.

sections.heading: Local storage and IndexedDB
paragraphs: We use localStorage for small preferences such as theme, language, cookie choice and install-prompt state. We use IndexedDB (via Dexie) for larger, structured records such as calculator inputs, counter state, checklist progress and draft inquiries so work survives a refresh or an unexpected shutdown.
These stores are scoped to your browser profile. Clearing site data removes them. Disabling storage may reduce saved-state features but will not block the core tools.

sections.heading: Google AdSense and DoubleClick DART cookies
paragraphs: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to our sites and/or other sites on the Internet.

DoubleClick/DART cookies may be set by the ad-serving infrastructure to record which advert was shown and to measure performance. We do not control those cookies directly; they are governed by Google's own policies.

Users may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings at https://adssettings.google.com. Users in the EEA, UK and other regulated regions are asked for consent before personalised ads are requested, and can revisit that choice from the Privacy choices link in the footer.

sections.heading: Third-party ad serving and measurement
paragraphs: When an advert is active, a request is made to Google's ad-serving domains. Those requests may include technical information such as IP address, user agent, referring page and cookie identifiers. Ad containers are reserved in advance so this process never shifts the layout.
We do not sell personal lists, and we do not place cross-site tracking pixels of our own. Analytics, if added later, will be disclosed here before activation.
bullets: Ad partner: Google AdSense / Google Advertising Products.

sections.heading: Children and sensitive data
paragraphs: SoftSutra tools are not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. Please do not enter passwords, full bank account numbers, medical records or other sensitive material into a demo widget.

sections.heading: Your rights and contact
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction you may have rights to access, correct, export or delete data. Write to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will respond within the period stated on the Contact page. You can also disable cookies in your browser, though this may affect advert relevance.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: These terms govern use of the SoftSutra portal and its sibling applications. By using them you accept the points below.

sections.heading: Permitted use
paragraphs: You may use SoftSutra tools for personal, educational, household and small-business purposes. You must not use them to harass, defraud, infringe rights, violate law, or overload the infrastructure with automated traffic.

sections.heading: Calculations and results
paragraphs: Outputs are estimates produced from the inputs you provide and the assumptions stated next to each tool. They are not professional tax, legal, medical, astrological or investment advice. Verify important decisions with a qualified professional.

sections.heading: Exam preparation
paragraphs: Mock tests are independent practice simulations. SoftSutra is not affiliated with any government body, examination authority, university or publisher. Syllabus patterns and marking schemes shown in practice material may differ from a live examination.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The layout, copy, icons, engines and data files of SoftSutra are protected. You may link to a tool, but you may not clone the interface, scrape content at scale, remove attribution, or distribute a modified copy as your own product without written permission.

sections.heading: Availability and changes
paragraphs: We work to keep tools available and offline-tolerant, but no uptime is guaranteed. Features may change as engines improve. Continued use after a published change means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent allowed by law, SoftSutra and its founder are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of a result, an offline cache, a third-party advert or a temporary outage.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.lead: Read this before relying on a number, a date, a diagnostic result or an educational preview from any SoftSutra property.

sections.heading: Financial and tax accuracy
paragraphs: EMI, GST, FD, SIP, discount and commission results use stated formulas and decimal half-up rounding. Actual lender amortisation, tax rules, surcharges, bank charges and state regulations can differ. Always confirm with your bank, a chartered accountant or the official tax portal before signing or filing.

sections.heading: Measurement and land data
paragraphs: Area, paint and construction estimates are mathematical approximations based on the dimensions you enter. They are not a legal survey. Property transactions require a licensed surveyor and registered documentation.

sections.heading: Network diagnostics
paragraphs: Latency, jitter and throughput readings are influenced by your device, browser, ISP routing, server load, Wi-Fi conditions and background traffic. A preview ping is an indicator, not a service-level measurement or a guarantee from an internet provider.

sections.heading: Panchang, Tithi and horoscope previews
paragraphs: Calendar and Kundli previews are illustrative. They use verified astronomical libraries and documented approximations; local sunrise, timezone, ayanamsa choice and ephemeris precision can change results. They are for cultural and educational reference, not for legal, medical or financial decisions.

sections.heading: Education
paragraphs: Exam questions, explanations and patterns shown in previews are practice material created for learning. They are not copied from a live examination and do not predict actual questions, cut-offs or rankings.

sections.heading: Documents and privacy
paragraphs: Checklists and readiness simulations do not guarantee that a cyber café, bank or government office will accept a document. Never share OTPs, PINs or full card numbers. SoftSutra does not act as your legal representative or data fiduciary for third-party portals.
